result.instructions: Tools for Inngest, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Inngest data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run inngest_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run inngest_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run inngest_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. inngest_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: inngest_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events received in the key's environment, newest first. Events are what start functions, so this is where an investigation begins. Inngest: GET /v1/events.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: inngest_get_event
tools.title: Get one event
tools.description: Fetch a single event with its name, payload and timestamp. Inngest: GET /v1/events/{eventId}.

tools.name: inngest_list_event_runs
tools.title: List the runs an event started
tools.description: List every function run one event triggered, with each run's status. This is the hop from 'this event arrived' to 'and here is what it did'. Inngest: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/runs.

annotations.title: List the runs an event started

tools.name: inngest_get_run
tools.title: Get one function run
tools.description: Fetch a single function run — its status, output and error. Inngest: GET /v1/runs/{runId}.

tools.name: inngest_list_run_jobs
tools.title: List a run's steps
tools.description: List the individual steps (jobs) of one run, with their status and timing — how you find which step of a durable function failed. Inngest: GET /v1/runs/{runId}/jobs.

tools.name: inngest_list_cancellations
tools.title: List bulk cancellations
tools.description: List bulk-cancellation jobs and their progress. Inngest: GET /v1/cancellations.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: inngest_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook ingresses configured for the environment — the external sources that turn into events. Inngest: GET /v1/webhooks.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: inngest_get_webhook
tools.title: Get one webhook
tools.description: Fetch a single webhook ingress with its URL and transform. Inngest: GET /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}.

tools.name: inngest_create_cancellation
tools.title: Bulk cancel function runs
tools.description: Cancel every run of one function that started within a time window, optionally narrowed by an event expression. This STOPS IN-FLIGHT WORK across your production functions — scope the window tightly. Runs already finished are unaffected. Inngest: POST /v1/cancellations.

app_id.description: The app the function belongs to, e.g. acme-app.

function_id.description: The function to cancel runs of, e.g. schedule-reminder.

started_after.description: ISO-8601 lower bound — only cancel runs that started after this.

started_before.description: ISO-8601 upper bound — only cancel runs that started before this.

if.description: Optional CEL expression to narrow further, e.g. event.data.userId == "user_123". Only matching runs are cancelled.

tools.name: inngest_delete_cancellation
tools.title: Stop a bulk cancellation
tools.description: Delete a bulk-cancellation job so it stops cancelling further runs. Runs it already cancelled stay cancelled. Inngest: DELETE /v1/cancellations/{cancellationId}.

tools.name: inngest_delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete a webhook
tools.description: Remove a webhook ingress. The external source stops producing events immediately. Inngest: DELETE /v1/webhooks/{webhookId}.
